explanation: He was bishop of Myra, near the south coast of Türkiye (Turkey), in the 4th century. In 1087 sailors from Bari carried his relics off to southern Italy.

claims.text: Saint Nicholas was bishop of Myra, in Lycia, which lies in modern Türkiye.
Saint Nicholas did not live in the Netherlands, Finland or Germany.
Nicholas of Myra lived in the 4th century AD.
In 1087 sailors from Bari took most of his relics from Myra to Bari, in southern Italy.
Myra lies near the south coast of Türkiye, at modern Demre.
